tweets: Bāhubali stands at Shravanabelagola — nearly 17 metres of monolithic granite, hewn from a single outcrop atop Vindhyagiri hill. Commissioned by Chāvuṇḍarāya, completed 981 CE; anointed anew every twelve years in the Mahāmastakābhiṣeka.

The 2018 Mahāmastakābhiṣeka drew over a million pilgrims, who climbed scaffolding to pour milk, turmeric, sandalwood paste and gold dust over Bāhubali's head and shoulders. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history.
